title: 使用Lora微调glm-4-9b-chat版本加载模型时遇到一个NoneType问题
bodyExcerpt:
### Reminder

- [x] I have read the above rules and searched the existing issues.

### System Info

- `llamafactory` version: 0.9.3.dev0
- Platform: Linux-5.4.119-19.0009.40-x86_64-with-glibc2.28
- Python version: 3.11.11
- PyTorch version: 2.7.0+cu126 (GPU)
- Transformers version: 4.51.3
- Datasets version: 3.5.0
- Accelerate version: 1.6.0
- PEFT version: 0.15.1
- TRL version: 0.9.6
- GPU type: NVIDIA H20
- GPU number: 8
- GPU memory: 95.00GB
- DeepSpeed version: 0.16.7
- Bitsandbytes version: 0.45.5
- Git commit: 52f25651a2016ddede2283be17cf40c2c1b906ed


### Reproduction

运行命令：CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 llamafactory-cli train examples/train_lora/glm4_9b_chat_sft.yaml 
yaml如下：
`model_name_or_path: /mnt/data/jackjqqwang/models/THUDM/glm-4-9b-chat  # 修改为你的模型实际路径

stage: sft


do_train: true
finetuning_type: lora

lora_target: all

dataset: 
eval_dataset: 

template: glm4
cutoff_len: 4608 #4608
max_samples: 10000
overwrite_cache: true
preprocessing_num_workers: 32

output_dir: saves/glm4-9b-chat/lora/interactive-nt-multi-chat
logging_steps: 6
save_steps: 6
plot_loss: true
overwrite_output_dir: true
per_device_train_batch_size: 4
gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
learning_rate: 5.0e-5
num_train_epochs: 10.0
lr_scheduler_type: cosine
warmup_ratio: 0.1
bf16: true  # 如果你支持 bfloat16
gradient_checkpointing: false
ddp_timeout: 180000000
per_device_eval_batch_size: 8
eval_strategy: steps
eval_steps: 6
deepspeed: examples/deepspeed/ds_z3_config.json
trust_remote_code: true`

运行出错：
Loading checkpoint shards:   0%|  | 0/10 [00:00<?, ?it/s][rank0]: Traceback (most recent call last):
[rank0]:   File /anaconda3/envs/llama_factory/lib/python3.11/site-packages/transformers/modeling_utils.py", line 5779, in caching_allocator_warmup
[rank0]:     re.compile("|".join([re.escape(plan) for plan in model._tp_plan]))
[rank0]:                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
[rank0]: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable
Loading checkpoint shards:   0%|  | 0/10 [00
author: JackeyWang777

summary.summaryZh: LlamaFactory使用LoRA微调GLM-4-9B-Chat时的模型加载：加载GLM-4-9B-Chat模型检查点时，Transformers的caching_allocator_warmup执行`model._tp_plan`迭代，因其为None触发`TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable`；训练在加载模型检查点阶段于0%处报错，无法继续
summary.impactScopeZh: 影响LlamaFactory 0.9.3.dev0中使用LoRA微调GLM-4-9B-Chat的训练启动流程。
evidence: 【标题】使用Lora微调glm-4-9b-chat版本加载模型时遇到一个NoneType问题
